Upsert Case From Lab Result.description: Creates or updates a Go.Data case, matched on visualId, from an incoming lab or surveillance record.

Upsert Contact.description: Creates or updates a contact of a case, matched on visualId.

Upsert Location From Facility Registry.description: Syncs a district or health facility from a master facility list or DHIS2 org unit into Go.Data locations.

Upsert Outbreak.description: Creates or updates an outbreak, matched on its Go.Data id.

Upsert Reference Data Item.description: Keeps a Go.Data reference data value (e.g. a centre name) in sync with an external code list.

List Cases In Outbreak.description: Lists every case in an outbreak, e.g. to push aggregates to DHIS2 or a dashboard.
List Cases In Outbreak.code:
// List all cases in an outbreak. Results are written to state.data.
listCases('3b5554d7-2c19-41d0-b9af-475ad25a382b');

Find Confirmed Cases.description: Queries an outbreak's cases with a Loopback filter.

List Contacts In Outbreak.description: Lists every contact in an outbreak, e.g. to build follow-up lists for field teams.
List Contacts In Outbreak.code:
// List all contacts in an outbreak. Results are written to state.data.
listContacts('3b5554d7-2c19-41d0-b9af-475ad25a382b');

Find Contact By Visual ID.description: Looks up a single contact by its visual id.

Find Outbreak By Name.description: Looks up an outbreak to get its id for later steps.
Find Outbreak By Name.code:
// Find an outbreak by name; its id is at state.data[0].id.
getOutbreak({ where: { name: 'Cholera 2026 - Northern Region' } });

Find Location By Name.description: Looks up a Go.Data location to map an incoming address to a locationId.
Find Location By Name.code:
// Find a location by name.
getLocation({ where: { name: 'Gulu District' } });

List Reference Data By Category.description: Fetches the allowed values for one reference data category.
